meta.name: remove-ai-marks
meta.description: Strip multi-vendor AI provenance from owned files: hidden Unicode (Layer A), statistical sampling watermarks via rewrite (Layer B — always offer), and C2PA/EXIF/XMP/container metadata on PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/PDF/DOCX/ODT/HTML/MD. Covers Claude, Gemini/SynthID-class, OpenAI provenance surfaces, and open-LLM sampling marks. Use when the user wants watermark removal, C2PA/Content Credentials stripping, AI metadata cleanup, invisible Unicode hygiene, anti-detect cleaning of AI output, /remove-ai-marks, or /remove-claude-marks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用本地服务来检查并清除文件里的 AI 痕迹,包括隐藏 Unicode 字符、抽样水印和 C2PA/EXIF 等元数据,并给出清理报告。
howto.when: 当你要求去除水印、清除 AI 元数据或处理反检测清理,或直接使用 /remove-ai-marks、/remove-claude-marks 时触发。
